verdict.reason: The exact frozen work and recurrence are independently reproducible, while all remaining gaps are implementation and admission gates rather than blockers to beginning RTL.

p1.finding: The premodel does not temporally compose the finite four-entry group FIFO, M216 ready/valid backpressure, service request acceptance, response drain, or cross-token overlap.
p1.required_close: Implement FIFO4 and cycle-account accepted frontend groups through finite service backpressure; prove no overflow, drop, duplicate, or stale delivery under randomized stalls before claiming achieved RTL cycles.

p1.finding: The recurrence is exact only for a fixed-latency, in-order response service.
p1.required_close: Keep the first RTL fail-closed to this contract, or add a tagged scoreboard/reorder path and separately prove variable-latency/out-of-order behavior.

p1.finding: Distinct modulo-eight sources remove within-group logical same-bank conflicts, but real SRAM ports, per-bank readiness, read-during-write behavior, routing, macro latency and II1 timing are not modeled.
p1.required_close: Bind one 128-bit slice read per active bank and cycle to an explicit eight-bank service interface, then run VCS and macro-aware Synopsys timing/power.

p1.finding: The premodel counts context hazards but does not prove signed INT8 weight extension, K1/K8 reduction order, Acc24 range, update forwarding, result slicing, saturation or rounding semantics.
p1.required_close: Add a bit-exact integer reference miter, overflow assertions, directed extrema and randomized K1/K8 grouping equivalence.

p1.finding: Epoch ownership, sequence tags, reset/soft-flush quarantine and stale-response rejection are outside the premodel.
p1.required_close: Use at least epoch16 plus request_seq32 ownership; increment epoch on soft flush, block new headers until a truthful memory flush acknowledgement, and reject pre-flush, duplicate, wrong-token and stale-epoch responses.

p1.finding: There is no M218 logic/macro area result and no cropped-K1 sensitivity.
p1.required_close: Use an eight-bank, O8, FIFO4, equal-context-storage K1 shadow as the primary physical baseline; report a native-cropped K1 only as a separately labelled conservative sensitivity.

p1.finding: Equal active reads and equal weight bytes establish work conservation, not equal or improved SRAM energy; the frontend/service intervals are mathematical envelopes rather than an executable composition.
p1.required_close: Measure switching and macro energy and replace the interval with a cycle-exact integrated RTL/model result before any energy, physical speedup or complete-FC2 wording.

independent_verification.payload_method: All 120 frozen FC2 files were checked for SHA256, byte extent and popcount; compact windows and bank populations were reconstructed without importing M168, M216 or M218 analyzers.

ordered_pairing_semantics.stage0: Each compacted D2 window is drained independently; groups are max per-bank population.
ordered_pairing_semantics.stage1_to_stage3: Only strict adjacent pairs (0,1),(2,3),... are combined; per bank, all older-window sources precede successor sources; pair groups are max(old+successor per-bank population).

attack_disposition.group_fifo4_not_timing_composed: P1 and mandatory integrated-RTL exit gate; not a blocker to opening RTL
attack_disposition.fixed_latency_in_order_response: explicit admitted premodel scope; any broader response model is NO-GO until separately proven
attack_disposition.real_bank_conflict_and_macro: logical distinct-bank feasibility passes; physical bank/macro feasibility remains P1
attack_disposition.out_of_order_response: not supported and must not be claimed
attack_disposition.accumulator_numeric: P1 and mandatory VCS reference-miter exit gate
attack_disposition.soft_flush_epoch: P1 and mandatory protocol exit gate
attack_disposition.cropped_k1_area: P1 sensitivity only; the primary comparison must remain resource matched

rtl_fail_closed_contract: Support only SOURCE_CAP in {1,8}, eight physical banks, 16 output lanes per slice, six slices per 96-lane output block, output_blocks in {1,2,4,8}, OUTSTANDING=8 and GROUP_FIFO_DEPTH=4; illegal parameters or headers must fail closed.

Preserve M216 group order and bank_valid/source identity under stall; FIFO occupancy must be exact and every accepted group must be issued once with no overflow, loss, duplication or cross-token leakage.
Permit at most one 128-bit read per active bank per issue edge and at most one read per physical bank per cycle; request acceptance must observe every selected bank's readiness.

Carry token_tag, epoch16, request_seq32, output_block, slice and bank-valid identity through all outstanding entries; fixed-latency in-order mode must reject wrong, duplicate, stale or unexpected responses.
If out-of-order response is enabled, add a finite scoreboard/reorder mechanism and retire each response exactly once to its owned context; do not silently reuse the in-order recurrence.
Enforce one owner per Acc24 output_block-by-slice context. A new same-context request may issue on the exact edge the previous response is accepted, never earlier.

Prove signed INT8 extension and K1/K8 arithmetic against a bit-exact Acc24 reference, including extrema, forwarding, zero-event tokens, overflow policy, result slicing and randomized group order permitted by the architecture.

Emit exactly six accepted result beats per output block for every accepted token, including zero-event tokens; token_done may occur only after the final result beat is accepted and must remain stable under backpressure.

On reset or soft flush, advance epoch, quarantine new headers until a truthful memory flush acknowledgement completes, and reject all responses from the old epoch; exercise initial-high acknowledgement, delayed stale response and reset/response collision attacks.
Instantiate scope-matched K1 and K8 with the same eight banks, FIFO4, O8, tag storage and Acc24 contexts; only SOURCE_CAP may differ for the primary performance/PPA comparison.
required_before_performance_admission: VCS/SVA directed plus constrained-random frontend-FIFO-service-accumulator composition with stalls and protocol attacks
cycle-exact frozen H67 replay through the integrated finite FIFO and response path
bit-exact numeric miter and response/tag/epoch conservation
matched K1/K8 Synopsys DC/STA/SAIF/PTPX with target SRAM macro or an explicitly pre-macro boundary
admitted_wording: On the frozen H67 FC2 payload, an independently reproduced fixed-latency, in-order pre-RTL model estimates 2,552,566,588 K1 versus 515,449,096 K8 standalone slice-service cycles at L4/O8/II1 (4.952121573x), with a conservative frontend/service interval lower bound of 4.214618919x. This is a premodel estimate, not achieved RTL, physical, complete-FC2/FFN or system speedup.
prohibited_wording: M218 achieves 4.2146x complete FC2, FFN, physical or system speedup
4.2146x is a measured end-to-end cycle result
equal active reads or weight bytes proves equal or lower energy
1024-bit/cycle is a synthesized or macro-qualified bandwidth
the real memory is conflict-free or sustains II1
the K8 speedup is fair against a physically cropped K1 baseline
